use_case_summary: Self-serve SMB building embeddable chat widget for merchants. Workload is high-volume short chats with bursty spikes during promotions. Need hosted API that can absorb bursts or provide graceful degradation (fallbacks) with clear retry guidance and cost controls.
technical_requirements: Handle traffic spikes of 150-400 concurrent short sessions for 5-10 minute promo windows
P95 latency target <200ms for typical short replies
Transparent rate-limit headers and clear 429 semantics for frontend retry logic
Prefer built-in caching for identical prompts and embedding reuse
Automatic fallback to cheaper model variant when quota/concurrency limits hit (soft degrade rather than hard errors)
po_constraints: Small budget for early pilot. If POC looks good, commit to hosted API monthly usage. No enterprise contract expected at sign-up.
value_drivers: Lower per-conversation token cost via batching & caching, predictable degradation policies during spikes, simple self-serve onboarding.
